gp.text: Gross profit for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 increased to $99.0 million from $97.0 million for the third quarter of fiscal 2024. The increase in gross profit was primarily due to an increase in average selling price per case and a decline in packaging costs, partially offset by the decrease in case volume. The average cost of sales per case remained constant and gross margin increased to 37.1% from 35.9% for the third quarter of fiscal 2024.

ga.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 decreased $0.5 million to $48.4 million from $48.9 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2024. The decrease was primarily due to a decrease in marketing and selling costs. As a percentage of net sales, selling, general and administrative expenses remained constant at 18.1% for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2024, respectively.

sga.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 decreased $0.5 million to $48.4 million from $48.9 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2024. The decrease was primarily due to a decrease in marketing and selling costs. As a percentage of net sales, selling, general and administrative expenses remained constant at 18.1% for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2024, respectively.

nonop.text: Other income, net includes interest income of $1.4 million for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 and $1.8 million for the third quarter of fiscal 2024. The decrease in interest income is due primarily to lower average invested balances.

ocf.text: Net cash provided by operating activities for the first nine months of fiscal 2025 was $146.6 million compared to $137.5 million for the first nine months of fiscal 2024. For the first nine months of fiscal 2025, cash flow provided by operating activities increased primarily due to an increase in net income, partially offset by increases in working capital excluding cash.

wc.text: At January 25, 2025, working capital decreased to $233.0 million from $398.9 million at April 27, 2024. The current ratio was 2.9 to 1 at January 25, 2025 compared to 3.9 to 1 at April 27, 2024. The decrease in working capital and current ratio was due primarily to the payment of the $304.1 million cash dividend. Trade receivables decreased $11.9 million and days sales outstanding decreased to 31.0 from 31.5 days. Inventories increased $0.4 and inventory turns remained constant at 8.6 times. Subsequent to January 25, 2025, the Company renewed two leases and entered into a new lease which will result in an increase in the operating lease right-of-use assets and associated operating lease liabilities of approximately $18 million.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
